snapshot.objective: Keep MD-OS continuity independent of Codex chat while private conversation follows physical folder copies, never normal Git transfers.
completed_results: Cortex loads a hash-bound public operational snapshot.
Fresh threads load a bounded tail of the private folder chronology without resuming Codex history.
Interactive turns append human inputs and the final answer to md-os/ops/local/cortex/conversation.ndjson.
Normal Git add, commit, push, and clone exclude the ignored private chronology.
Only explicit /resume requests provider-side Codex history.
decisions: Canonical identity remains separate; this public snapshot is non-canonical working context.
Git carries reviewed public continuity; physical folder copies also carry ignored private chronology.
Private records omit reasoning traces, tool traces, model IDs, and Codex thread IDs.
open_risks: A bounded history excerpt reaches the configured model provider; fully offline inference needs a local model.
git add -f can bypass ignore, so staged paths must be inspected.
Turns predating this feature are not reconstructed.
next_actions: Restart Cortex and run the documented directory-copy canary test.
